name: Avarole AI Assistant
author: qordenai

sections.description:
Avarole is a customer-support platform with an AI virtual assistant and a support-ticket desk. This plugin puts your Avarole assistant on your WordPress site.

  • A floating avatar button appears on your pages. Visitors can talk or type to it.
  • The assistant answers from the knowledge you give it in Avarole.
  • Visitors can leave a support ticket; replies reach them by email or WhatsApp.
  • Optional visitor insights show where people drop off (page paths only, never what they type).

You need an Avarole account and an agent. Create them at https://app.avarole.com.

External services

This plugin loads a script from, and sends visitor data to, the Avarole service. The service is required for the assistant to work.

  • Service: Avarole, https://app.avarole.com
  • What is loaded: https://app.avarole.com/widget.js, on every front-end page of your site once you switch the assistant on.
  • What is sent: your API key and Agent ID (to identify your agent); the messages and voice a visitor gives the assistant; the page address (without query string) the visitor is on; and, if you leave “Visitor insights” on, page paths, the steps and friction on your pages (never what visitors type). Visitors who send Do Not Track are not counted.
  • Connecting: when you press “Connect Avarole”, your browser goes to https://app.avarole.com/connect/wordpress where you sign in and pick an agent. The plugin then sends your site address and a one-time code to https://app.avarole.com/wordpress/connect/exchange and receives the agent’s website key.
  • Account status: once connected, the plugin asks https://app.avarole.com/wordpress/status (with your key) for the agent name and plan, at most every 10 minutes while you view the plugin’s settings page.
  • Terms of service: https://avarole.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy policy: https://avarole.com/privacy-policy

Nothing is sent until you enter your key, enter an Agent ID and switch the assistant on.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings, Avarole AI and press “Connect Avarole”.
  3. Sign in to Avarole (or create an account), choose the agent to show and allow. You return to WordPress with the assistant switched on.
  4. Choose a plan on Avarole if you need more than the free allowance (button “Plans and billing”).

Prefer to paste the key yourself? Open “Enter the key by hand instead” on the same page and paste the API key and Agent ID from the agent’s Build page, Website integration.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Avarole account?

Yes. You can create one while connecting. Plans are bought and paid at https://app.avarole.com, as on avarole.com, not in WordPress.

Can I hide it from administrators?

Yes, tick “Hide the assistant while I am logged in as an administrator”.

How do I remove it?

Untick “Show the assistant” or deactivate the plugin. Deleting the plugin removes its settings.
